bagPolicy.summary: All guests entering U.S. Bank Stadium will have their bags searched and scanned. Permissible bags will be allowed after inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are over 20,000 parking spaces available within a 20-minute walk of U.S. Bank Stadium. Parking lots typically open six hours before events and close two hours after. Accessible parking is available in all lots and ramps.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in U.S. Bank Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: U.S. Bank Stadium offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, including local Minnesota flavors. Highlights include bratwurst, cheeseburgers, cheese curds, and a variety of snacks like popcorn and nachos. Beverage options feature craft beers and cocktails.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Bank Stadium is designed with accessible parking, accessible vehicle drop off areas, power-assisted doors, restrooms, concessions, water fountains, ATMs, seating areas, assistive listening devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in U.S. Bank Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Bank Stadium Ticket Office is located on the Northwest corner of the stadium between the Legacy and Polaris Gates.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at U.S. Bank Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
